direction: C2 emits; C1 and C3 consume independently

1.3.0: ADDED an optional human_approved_at to VerdictOverridden, and gave the event an explicit properties block naming its snake_case wire keys. An override into APPROVED is a human approval and must carry the real human-click timestamp, exactly as VerdictIssued does (REQ-021, no auto-approval); an override into any non-APPROVED verdict carries null. Populated only when override_verdict == APPROVED. Optional (not in required) because the field is meaningless for the common non-APPROVED override; the persistence boundary (ComplianceEventEmitter) rejects an APPROVED override whose human_approved_at is null, so the invariant is enforced in code, not by schema requiredness. Closes audit 2026-07-14 finding #1. Additive; no field renamed, removed, or re-typed.
1.2.0: ADDED rng_seed and sampler_version to AmplificationAllocated, both in the required array. The explore arm draws from a Beta posterior via Thompson sampling; a Beta draw is floating-point and library-dependent, so an allocation is reproducible from the event log only if the seed AND the sampler library version travel with it. An allocation that cannot be re-derived is not auditable, and the REQ-039 counterfactual cannot be reconstructed against it. Required from inception (greenfield: no historical AmplificationAllocated event exists to invalidate) because an optional seed is a seed that will be omitted. Additive; no field renamed, removed, or re-typed.
1.1.0: ADDED EXCLUDED_FROM_AI_SCORING to VerdictIssued.verdict enum. V6 (minor_creator) resolves on_fail to EXCLUDED_FROM_AI_SCORING (rubric-v1.json:20), a routing state distinct from REJECTED: a minor's submission is excluded entirely from AI scoring, a different act with a different record. Without this value a V6-excluded minor could only be misrecorded as one of the four REQ-015 verdicts. Additive to the enum; no field renamed, removed, or re-typed.

idempotency_key.description: hash(event_type, entity_id, logical_timestamp). Consumers dedupe on this. A double-counted outcome inflates an effect size.

invariants: No event carries a raw media URI. Events reference feature_record_id only, so that de-identification after the rights window does not invalidate the log.
arm is stamped on AmplificationAllocated and propagates to every subsequent PerformanceSnapshot for that live_post_id.
breaker_state_at_score travels with the score. It is never reconstructed from flag history.
Every metric carries provenance and as_of. Proxy is never aggregated as Measured.
C1 and C3 are consumers only. Neither writes to this stream.

cohort_key.description: The calibration cohort key. Library promotion changes this key and resets the window.

version_triple.description: Pinned at score time. Re-running against the same triple yields the same number.

shadow_scores.description: Present only when breaker_state_at_score = shadow. Challenger library scores, stored, never surfaced.

criteria.description: Per-criterion 0-100 with evidence and degraded flag

retrieved_pattern_ids.description: The evidence a score was anchored on. Makes the score explainable and auditable.

anomalous.description: Model returned out-of-range. Clamped, logged, EXCLUDED from calibration dataset.

suspected_vetoes.description: Model-raised, surfaced to a human, NEVER read by veto computation.

human_approved_at.description: REQ-021. No auto-approval. APPROVED without this is invalid.

VerdictOverridden.description: A first-class calibration input, not an exception path. High override rate in a cohort means the rubric is wrong.

human_approved_at.description: REQ-021 (1.3.0). Set only when override_verdict == APPROVED: the real human-click timestamp. An APPROVED override with this null is rejected at the persistence boundary. Null for every non-APPROVED override.

live_disclosure_verified.description: REQ-034. The compliant artefact and the published artefact are different objects.

denominator.description: Declared and period-stable. Rates on different denominators are not compared.

arm.description: Propagated from AmplificationAllocated. Null if unamplified. The most valuable field in the system.

as_of.description: True collection time, not intended horizon. Log lag makes these differ.

insufficient_baseline.description: creator.trailing_posts_n < 8. Never imputed from creator tier.

arm.description: Explore-arm outcomes are the ONLY unconfounded evidence C1 receives. Dropping this tag converts the exploration budget into a donation.

aws_terms.description: Per-term contribution. vps_normalised weight is 0 when breaker tripped.

rng_seed.description: REQUIRED (1.2.0). The seed of the injected RNG the Thompson draw used. Makes the allocation re-derivable from the event log; an allocation without one is unreproducible and its REQ-039 counterfactual cannot be reconstructed.

sampler_version.description: REQUIRED (1.2.0). The sampler library version. A Beta draw is floating-point and library-dependent, so the seed alone guarantees reproducibility only within one environment.

modifications.description: REQ-037. Nothing reaches a client before this event exists.

evidence_uri.description: A grant without evidence is not a grant. organic_publish NEVER implies paid_amplification.

contract_c_breaker_state.direction: C3 writes; C2 reads. C2 has no write path.

armed.condition: rolling spearman >= 0.35 on n >= 60 held out
armed.c2_behaviour: VPS surfaced with band; weight 0.15 in AWS

tripped.c2_behaviour: VPS stored not surfaced; weight 0 in AWS; redistributed to measured terms

cold.condition: n < 60, or no library, or compatibility triple mismatch
cold.c2_behaviour: same as tripped; reason differs and is surfaced

rules: Automatic to trip. Manual, with a recorded reason, to arm.
Fail closed: unreachable C3 or cache stale beyond 60s TTL => treat cohort as cold.
No configuration in C2 overrides a breaker. A breaker switchable from the component it governs is a comment.
REQ-038 client behaviour is a direct read of this state, not a second decision.

contract_d_library_verdict.direction: C1 requests shadow; C3 issues verdict. C1 cannot publish without it.
rules: Challenger must beat incumbent on the SAME held-out submissions. Paired comparison controls for the quarter.
extend_shadow is the common outcome and costs only doubled model spend.
reject is recorded against the candidate and its mining run.
On promote, C3 resets the calibration window. Breaker drops to cold until n rebuilds.
Publication cadence is bounded below by calibration accumulation (~quarterly), NOT by mining cadence (nightly).
